$comment: Patient-facing urgent messages. R21 and R22 wording approved by the clinical lead on 2026-10-03 (DEC-16). The urgent-lab wording is still DRAFT for clinical-lead review (AMB-08). Urgent messages may say 'call 911/988'; that is a safety instruction, not a treatment instruction.
R21: Some of what you reported can be a sign of a serious problem. If you have chest pain, fainted, have severe trouble breathing, or feel confused, call 911 now. Otherwise, contact your care team today.
R22: Thank you for telling us. You don't have to go through this alone. If you are thinking about hurting yourself, call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline) now, or call 911 if you are in immediate danger. Please also let your care team know how you are feeling.
urgent_lab: One of your recent blood test results needs prompt attention. Please contact your care team today. If you feel very unwell, call 911.
urgent_lab_clinician: Lab value at the urgent limit per DEC-06; urgent pathway, not ranked with other findings.
